strengths: Both Phase 9 holdouts are candidate wins.
Readiness explicitly grants no packaging, push or PR authority.

findings.issue: Source checks that the credential-redaction pre-push hook is installed (including custom core.hooksPath); the Skill only says 'secret indicators'.
findings.recommendation: Add 'redaction pre-push hook present, honouring core.hooksPath' as a named check.

findings.issue: Sibling-worktree and version-queue collision detection from the landing report is dropped.
findings.recommendation: Add a check for other active branches claiming the same version slot.

strengths: Bisectable commits and no-push boundary are explicit.
Both Phase 9 holdouts are candidate wins.

findings.issue: Version-state classification before bumping (FRESH vs ALREADY_BUMPED vs needs repair) is absent, so repeated packaging can double-bump the version.
findings.recommendation: Require classifying current version state against the base before any version write.

findings.issue: WIP-commit handling and the anti-footgun rule 'never destroy non-WIP commits; stop and ask when unsure' are dropped.
findings.recommendation: Add WIP-only detection and a stop condition before any history rewrite.

lost_source_techniques: WIP-only branch soft reset with non-WIP preservation

strengths: Local-config-only boundary and teardown plan are explicit.

findings.issue: Platform detection from repository files (fly.toml, vercel.json, netlify.toml, render.yaml, workflows) and per-platform URL/health/status inference are absent; step 2 says 'select from approved constraints' without detection.
findings.recommendation: Add a detection table mapping config files to platform adapters and derived health/status commands.

findings.issue: Output 'local deployment configuration candidate' has no schema; the source defines a fixed deploy-configuration block (platform, production URL, workflow, status command, merge method, health check, hooks).
findings.recommendation: Adopt that block as the required output schema consumed by readiness and trigger Skills.

strengths: One-attempt authorization with receipt, request hash and cancellation path.

findings.issue: Auto-deploy-on-merge platforms (Vercel, Netlify) need no trigger; the Skill has no 'not applicable' path and may fabricate a trigger action.
findings.recommendation: Add a first check: if the configured platform deploys automatically, return not-applicable and hand off to deployment-observation.

findings.issue: Run identification by matching the merge commit SHA and preferring the detected deploy workflow name is dropped.
findings.recommendation: Require the run receipt to bind to the exact head or merge SHA.

lost_source_techniques: auto-deploy platforms need no explicit trigger
match workflow run by merge SHA

strengths: Bindings by reference and wildcard-route block are domain-specific.

findings.issue: Source warns that a successful dry run proves build and packaging only, not remote resources or runtime behaviour; the Skill treats preview as a gate without stating that limit.
findings.recommendation: State that dry-run success does not validate bindings or runtime and require the health handoff to check them.

findings.issue: Regenerating binding types after config change instead of hand-editing generated declarations is dropped.
findings.recommendation: Add type regeneration and typecheck to the local validation step.

findings.issue: Overlap 0.348 with web-hosting-deployment; neither names the other as an anti-trigger.
findings.recommendation: Add mutual anti-triggers keyed on 'edge runtime/bindings/routes' vs 'static or SSR hosting project'.

lost_source_techniques: dry run does not prove remote resources

strengths: Server-side diff rejection of unexpected namespace, identity or immutable-field changes.

findings.issue: The source's deploy-failure catalog (DS001-DS013) and rollback reference are not mapped to stop conditions.
findings.recommendation: Map known failure codes to stop and recovery actions in step 3.

strengths: Rejects stale, self-attested or waived evidence.
Both Phase 9 holdouts are candidate wins.

findings.issue: First-run dry-run validation keyed on a deploy-config hash is dropped.
findings.recommendation: Flag first run or changed deploy config as requiring a dry-run verdict.

lost_source_techniques: first-run confirmation keyed on deploy-config hash

strengths: One comment, no thread resolution, no source change.

findings.issue: Line-level review comments and top-level conversation comments use different reply endpoints; the Skill does not distinguish them, so a reply can land on the wrong thread.
findings.recommendation: Require classifying comment type and binding the reply target accordingly.

strengths: Exact refspec, expected remote SHA, non-force default.
Both Phase 9 holdouts are candidate wins.

findings.issue: Credential redaction pre-push hook check is generalized to 'secret checks'.
findings.recommendation: Name the redaction hook check explicitly.

strengths: Rejects auto-merge enabling and source changes.

findings.issue: Source requires regenerating the PR body from this run's fresh results on update and never reusing stale body content; the Skill does not.
findings.recommendation: Add a rule: updates replace the body from current evidence; stale sections are removed.

findings.issue: Redaction must scan both title and body at the sink and refuse when the scan cannot run.
findings.recommendation: State scan-at-sink for title and body with refuse-on-scan-failure.

lost_source_techniques: regenerate PR body from scratch on update
redaction scan at sink, refuse if unscannable

strengths: Branch deletion requires separate authority, a deliberate tightening of the source.

findings.issue: Merge queues and auto-merge are not addressed: in queue-protected repositories a direct merge fails, and enqueueing is a different action with deferred result.
findings.recommendation: Define queue entry as an allowed method returning 'queued' with a pending-result handoff, never a merged claim.

strengths: Exact project, environment, domain and rollback target.

findings.issue: Git-integrated hosting deploys by commit and push; the Skill does not say that this path must route to change-packaging and remote-git-push instead of being performed here.
findings.recommendation: Add: when the provider deploys from Git, return a handoff to remote-git-push; this Skill covers CLI or API deploys only.

findings.issue: Deploy method selection by link/remote state and the tarball fallback are dropped.
findings.recommendation: Add a method-selection step with these states.

lost_source_techniques: deploy method selection by link and git state

cross_skill_findings.issue: Three deploy Skills share an identical four-step skeleton; separation is justified by different failure modes but neither the shared skeleton nor the discriminator is stated.
cross_skill_findings.recommendation: Keep separate; add a one-line discriminator and mutual anti-triggers to each.
